title: JHPCE production job aborts on the node: tests/scvi needs tag prereg-tier12-v1, which the bundle clone does not carry
description: prod_fit_job.sh runs `pytest tests/scvi` in a repo cloned from a git bundle that holds one refs/heads ref (the rehearsal's documented recipe; prod_command.py clones `$PWD/wcd.bundle`). test_baseline_guard.py resolves the tagged fitter with `git show prereg-tier12-v1:scripts/fit_paper_config.py` (check=True). The clone has no tags, so 2 tests fail and the job exits 2 before any fit, after the queue wait (7.8 h measured for a 2-h L40S job). The lead's rehearsal (at 0a87280) predates this test.
evidence: cluster/jhpce/local_rehearsal.sh at 080f417, both jobs: exit 2, 'FATAL: tests/scvi failed on this node', '2 failed, 108 passed, 1 skipped' (rr/out/rehearsal_jobA|B). Bundle simulation: 0 tags in clone, `git show prereg-tier12-v1:...` exit 128; `git archive eb444fe` (test_kl_warmup) works. Same rehearsal with refs/tags/prereg-tier12-v1 added to the bundle: both exit 0, tests 110 passed / 1 skipped, fingerprints 8/8, runner dry run 100 / 150 rows (keys ...__tags-d5da370a4d0c, ...__tags-91daef08ab82).
suggested_fix: Either pin the test to the commit (git show 129142b...:scripts/fit_paper_config.py, as test_kl_warmup pins eb444fe) or bundle the tag (git bundle create wcd.bundle <ref> refs/tags/prereg-tier12-v1 [refs/tags/prereg-tier12-v2]) and change local_rehearsal.sh and the documented submit recipe to match; then re-run local_rehearsal.sh for jobA and jobB at the commit to be tagged.

The evidence row is tag X3_pancreas_none_l0_c1_s10_31994c65, whose spec has deplete_pct 50, and the latent is the first 10 columns of the prepped HVG PCA (regress_pcr_reference.py make-latent), not a fit.

title: scorer_git_sha is repository HEAD, so any later commit (incl. notebook-only) splits a rule input; run_A1.sh invites 'v2 or later'
stages_affected: R2/R3 (A1 + A2/A3 rows), R4 with extension rows, SI-45 rows
description: prereg_rules refuses a rule input whose rows differ in scorer_git_sha. R2/R3 read A1 rows (scored at the tag) together with A2/A3 rows and SI-45 / R4 extension rows scored days later. The repository receives notebook commits several times a day; scoring any of those rows from a checkout one commit later makes R2/R3 refuse until ~1,100 A1 rows are re-scored. The failure is loud (no wrong result), but the run sheet does not say how to avoid it, and run_A1.sh says 'tag prereg-tier12-v2 or later'.
evidence: Code read at 080f417; tests/prereg/test_provenance_rule.py::test_mixed_provenance_is_refused passes (other suite 311 passed).
suggested_fix: State in run_A1.sh and the later stage launchers that every stage runs from one worktree pinned at the tag (notebook commits from another worktree), or key provenance on a hash of the scorer files plus package versions instead of HEAD.

title: harvest_local.py protects only a 'tier12' path component; the restarted A1 lives in tier12_v2/A1
description: The guard refuses --dest with a path component equal to 'tier12'. tier12_v2 is not matched, so a mistyped --dest could merge a harvest into the new A1 tree.
suggested_fix: Refuse any component starting with 'tier12' (or the A1 out dir explicitly).

title: SI-45 rows overwrite --extension-manifest unconditionally
description: At the freezing run the SI-45 default-half rows are written to --extension-manifest with os.replace. Passing the previous round's extension path (the usage shows one file per round) silently replaces that round's R4 extension manifest, which later rule calls need.
evidence: Code read; tests/prereg/test_si45_edge_extension.py uses a fresh path.
suggested_fix: Refuse an existing --extension-manifest path in the freezing run (or use a distinct default name for SI-45 rows).
